criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered on a dark field; six do real work at 432 px: 2's relief shows the growth without counting; 3 now a true relief with measured height and the bars at 55:70 against a saw-cut ruler, fixing the strip in a void; 5 counts 7, 7 plus a saw cut, 8; 6 seats the resident on the panel; 9 seated and lit; 4's amber row clear of the claim line. Held down: 7 broad brown mid-tone planks, the new panel not a picture of removal directed; 8 a flat grille-like rectangle; 4's field bleeds both edges as wallpaper; 1's car primitive with a flat black windshield.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck: thermoplastic on near-black asphalt, key left and casts right, terracotta held to 6 to 9, value dark, the road-paint motif changing state frame by frame, the one-corner camera move 1, 6, 7. 3 and 8 read slightly as boards set into the world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the roll calls counted from vote rows; the first comment's 15 official records and two news reports match its list; the Tribune figures attributed; slide 8 discloses Houston Public Media's 'within 72 hours' beside the Tribune's clock. Held under 9: slide 4's legend over a field cut at both edges; the ballot wording rests on one county's sample ballot for a two-county city.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where (both counties), when and the twist named. The only hours are Harris County's and no surface says Galveston's were not read; the caption's closing question has no answer; nothing says what the cameras record (c34 unused).

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, frame 2 pays at once, 6 to 7 the real turn, 8 the clock, 9 the next step. Slide 3 a defensive correction; slide 5's headline cryptic until the dek.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, every house rule held, some good lines. Much reads as an attribution ledger; 'Drawn to illustrate.' closes all nine; 'Seven For' and 'can look' flat; the closing question an engagement device.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The technique fresh; the subject not: no. 39 thirty days ago named the vote and Laredo's referendum and this close repeats its ending. The topics differ and dedupe_check passed, so charged here. The register and the night-road cover follow recent decks.

ship_note: No hard fail. 7.494 is under the 7.7 rung; round 3 is the cap, so the deck ships with the shortfall named.
one_sentence_fix: Give the reader the action half: a where-and-when line for both counties, or say plainly that Galveston County's hours were not read, and spend slide 3 on what the cameras record.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Broad brown mid-tone plank tops, no single subject; the panel does not show removal directed.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the top albedo so only chamfers catch the key; dolly low over the panel so it owns the lower left third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The field bleeds both edges at even brightness, wallpaper; the legend can't be checked.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so the block sits inside with a dark margin; pool the key on the front rows and the amber markers.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat evenly lit rectangle of grooves, a vent grille; CERTIFIED floats above the strip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighten the pool on the start bar and row 1; set CERTIFIED beside the start bar with a leader.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A primitive car body, flat black windshield, blank plate.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: An environment reflection in the glass, a warm rim, the headlight throw on a fictional plate.
